The upper reduction has positive antisymmetry coefficient D(z), and Phi is strictly concave with a single interior maximum at r. The cubic remainder factorization has positive factors for all z in [0,1]. The checked exact identity and analytic inequalities cover boundaries and equality cases; finite sampling is not used as proof.
